method: Read-only source review under code-review skill and ADR-002. Read current two migrated fixtures, initial diff-resume.patch and exact five native failure records. No Unity/test execution or Git command/source modification by reviewer.
verdict: bounded source and old-fixture migration accepted; no remaining blocking findings
ADR_002: Rules/runtime and manager adapters remain layered; no UI ownership of game resources; no new package/settings/scene lifecycle change.

production_findings.original_card_and_atomic_commit: Original instances and source-value snapshots retained. IT and D05 plans both validate before a single card-group removal; same-card conflict rejects in both directions, independent targets each apply one delta. No shared CardData.value or RP mutation.
production_findings.lifecycle: Free cancellation/stale failure does not spend; actual final card commitment spends once. Owner/input/version/session/init binding and cleanup invalidate pending intent without refunding committed uses during the race (spin/skip/terminal). Initialize reconstructs clean runtime and ordinary new-race uses on restart.
production_findings.clock_guard_fixed: AscariPrecisionRuntime.BeginInput now rejects null race/player, AI, disabled state and wrong active skill before opening scope/incrementing InputsStarted. Disabled/AI two new unit cases retain uses/deck and assert no target/scope/input count.
production_findings.hotpot_fixed: Ordinary card body movement is independent of ATTACK corner-speed exclusion. Source-first D05 and IT reductions each preserve -1 movement even at corner floor0. Only ordinary body movement establishes first-apex reach; Hotpot additional+1 and unsettled driver tail cannot be borrowed. Actual base distance is capped to that body; forecast uses copied state.
production_findings.safety_and_tail: Ordered first ordinary-base apex must be physically reached and current corner speed safe at effective limit; reward is one-shot. Tail newly crossed apexes retain ordinary payment/spin path. Old D05 limit+1 and generic heat-1 removed.
production_findings.prediction: New runtime copy/rebind and copied deck/tech state keep repeated projections from consuming real resources or uses.
production_findings.player_UI_boundary: D05 real target chooser and passive remain unimplemented/explicitly unaccepted in this API slice. UI implementation-progress text was removed from player label.

old_fixture_migration.failure_cause: All five expected legacy untargeted TryActivate=true for D05, now intentionally rejected by production target-plan contract.
old_fixture_migration.reaction_3_cases: Ascari levels3/5/7 now use owned RaceSession participant, original speed2, eligible first apex, real Prepare and CardPlayRules group commit. Pre/post-disabled reaction0 and active TrueSelf-only reaction1 assertions, repeated calls and uses/duration/ActivatedThisTurn checks remain; Precision.Version/Target nonconsumption assertions added.
old_fixture_migration.movement_2_cases: Ascari crossedCorner=false/true now use actual original4+2 group, target4, real owner input and eligible path. Original Hotpot4/signed trick-2/sum order, repeated read-only checks, uses/duration/rhythm version, position9/gear2 assertions remain. New exact corner1 and Precision.Target/Version/value assertions strengthen independent reduction and no mutation.
old_fixture_migration.no_delete_skip_or_weaken: No Test/TestCase skip, Assert.Ignore, deleted failed case or weakened reaction/order/value assertion introduced by these two final migrations. Expected signed bonus remains3: Hotpot5 plus trick-2; corner1 is ordinary6 minus ATTACK4 minus D05delta1.

validation_boundary: Review is source-only. Parent reported focused50/50 and ten actual GameLoops on production runtime ad6daf92; final module run on editor13f514c8 must be verified by parent. Do not use prior assemblies or review as executed test evidence.
